verdict.rationale: Fathom automatically generates AI action items (fathom-docs-28) and provides webhooks/API that can include action items in structured data delivered to a destination URL (fathom-docs-22, fathom-docs-45), giving PMs a trackable, centralized feed of action items with meeting context. Core capability is well documented and includes runtime confirmation the API is live; missing for 10: explicit evidence of an in-app dashboard specifically tracking action items by owner over time (e.g., a dedicated action-items view) beyond the webhook/API delivery mechanism.
